label: Quora Ads
terms_note: No public management API: only the Conversion API is self-serve; the management / reporting API is a closed partner beta (join-API-beta form). The ToS / acceptable-use pages returned 403 on 2026-09-23, so no browser automation

discovery.auth: token (Conversion API uses a pixel-scoped token; reporting API is issued to approved partners)

auth: 1. Advertiser account in Quora Ads Manager (business.quora.com → "Get started").
2. Conversion API: a pixel-scoped access token generated in Ads Manager (TODO(verify) exact location) sent with each server-side event.
